notes.title: Find Eden Demo small-patch #1
notes.content:
Hey, we are listening to people`s feedback :D

Slowly we are gathering data and start fixing the Demo.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966815/f82463b28eeac9b52f067984a8bca6a9e37a54e1.png
In this patch we fixed the followings:

 Made big tree interaction mandatory and it opens on collision now
 Fixed 'Floating Ground' Interaction
 Fixed an event limit: While in the scene with the cat in the tree, you cannot go beyond the big tree, the game stops you. After you defeat the ugly snail, the game now enables you to keep exploring beyond the tree
 Fixed Cat interaction in the cave
 Fixed 'Credits' text

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966815/e5c70a9a8d89d5e384f5515c98fb5dbcd5f2a0b3.png

Next steps:
- Make Timmy feel more scared in the new Realm
- Tweak the music
- Make the player movement less glitchy
- Make monster AIs more real

Thank you for the feedback everyone! We are always looking forward to seeing you engage with our game!

notes.title: Development Blog November: Intrigue
notes.content:
About this post
We gave Timmy`s house an upgrade and added more easter eggs to it!
This month we have focused on establishing a stable story behind Find Eden. We honestly think that what we are trying to create will leave players speechless and in love with the world we are creating due to its rich attention to detail and how human-like the characters are.


Updates

 Gameplay instructions: Cutscene for intrigue added
 New House design: Our designer updated the house image so that it includes now even more details and hidden easter eggs!
 Added a new item: We added this amazing book that Timmy reads before sleep

Next steps
The following week we will focus on:

 sound design
 atmospheric details
 cat animations

notes.title: Starting Regular Updates
notes.content:
Getting ready!
You deserve some updates regarding this game and I hope you are tuning into that Halloween vibe, because Timmy surely is!

What`s the status of the project?
We are preparing to release a Demo soon, that will include a lot of the core elements of the final product.

What will the demo include?
In Find Eden the focus is mostly on the story. You will be put in a fantastic fantasy world, where you get to discover peculiar characters, such as Timmy (aka the main character). 

The demo gives you the opportunity to explore Timmy`s realm and understand what type of personality he has, until the unexpected happens and his lifetime adventure begins.

Why is the development so slow?
Find Eden is developed by a small indie studio made out of 2 people, who work on the game after the normal working hours, but I promise the experience is worth playing once it is released, so stay tuned!
